phase_name: Offline Local Runtime Package & Sync Readiness

test_cases.name: test_first_offline_launch_clean_environment
test_cases.description: Clean startup with empty cache and empty DB renders honest empty state with 0 fake demo roster entries (BUG-ARCH-003 verification)

test_cases.name: test_offline_capability_detection
test_cases.description: Detects offline network state, database read/write status, available models, and cached courses

test_cases.name: test_cached_course_import_and_checksum_verification
test_cases.description: Imports valid course package into local cache, verifies SHA-256 checksum, and queries metadata

test_cases.name: test_corrupted_cache_detection_and_quarantine
test_cases.description: Tampered or corrupted course package is detected, quarantined, and reported cleanly without crashing

test_cases.name: test_uncached_course_honest_degraded_state
test_cases.description: Requesting an uncached course offline cleanly raises OfflineCourseNotCachedError with actionable guidance

test_cases.name: test_local_tutor_turn_offline_execution
test_cases.description: Executes a complete tutor turn offline using cached curriculum, scoped RAG, and transactional persistence

test_cases.name: test_local_state_persistence_across_restart
test_cases.description: Enrolls student, executes turns, shuts down runtime, starts new instance; 100% of state is preserved

test_cases.name: test_interrupted_turn_transactional_rollback
test_cases.description: Simulates mid-turn crash; restarts runtime; verifies partial turn was rolled back and DB remains consistent

test_cases.name: test_read_only_database_degraded_mode
test_cases.description: Makes local database read-only; verifies runtime enters graceful READ_ONLY_MODE, blocking writes

test_cases.name: test_missing_model_honest_alert_and_prompt
test_cases.description: When requested offline model is missing, returns ModelUnavailableError with actionable prompt

test_cases.name: test_zero_fake_demo_roster_in_bridge_and_portal
test_cases.description: Tests app/bridge/facade.py with clean DB; verifies 0 fake students (Rahul Kumar, Priya Sharma, Amit Patel) exist

test_cases.name: test_zero_chemistry_coupling_in_local_runtime
test_cases.description: Scans AST and lines of all local_runtime/ files, verifying zero hardcoded chemistry keywords
